title: Let admins refund an order
body: Adds POST /orders/:id/refund so support can refund a paid order in full without editing the database. The old dashboard still posts to /refunds/:id, so that path stays as an alias.

labels.note: Both refund paths, POST /orders/:id/refund and POST /refunds/:id, are registered with requireUser only. Cancel, the other admin action, also has requireAdmin, so any signed-in member can refund any paid order in full. Commit 2 adds requireAdmin to the first path only, so the alias still lets any member refund.
